# `database.aug`

<a id="symbol-storedName"></a>
## `storedName` · [source](database.aug#L5)

Store a bound value in an in-memory SQLite database and read it back. Failures can raise [`SqliteError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/contracts.aug.md#symbol-SqliteError).

It calls [`openMemory`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-openMemory) and stores the result in owned `database` ([`Database`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Database)). With temporary permission to change `database`, it calls [`execute`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-execute) with `database`, `sql` `"CREATE TABLE users (name TEXT NOT NULL)"`, and `parameters` from a list with no items; then it calls [`execute`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-execute) with `database`, `sql` `"INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES (?)"`, and `parameters` from a list containing `"August"`. It returns [`queryScalar`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-queryScalar) with `database`, `sql` `"SELECT name FROM users"`, and `parameters` from a list with no items.

## `test storedName` · [source](database.aug#L12)

Tests [`storedName`](database.aug.md#symbol-storedName). Each case gets fresh setup and dependencies.

### `database`

#### `inserts_and_queries_bound_data` · [source](database.aug#L14)

The test requires [`storedName`](database.aug.md#symbol-storedName) equals `"August"`.

## Dependencies

It uses [`execute`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-execute), [`openMemory`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-openMemory), [`queryScalar`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/api.aug.md#symbol-queryScalar), [`Database`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Database), and [`SqliteError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-sqlite/0.1.3/contracts.aug.md#symbol-SqliteError) from `https://github.com/GreenPandaStudios/aug-sqlite#v0.1.3`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
